module page.titles
  purpose: Measure the title of a web page for agents.

import std.http as web
import std.http exposing Url

public type PageError is one of
  BadUrl(address: Text)
  FetchFailed(address: Text)
  NoTitle(address: Text)
end

public function title_length(html: Text, address: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  purpose: Count the characters inside the title element of an HTML text, failing with NoTitle when there is none.
  tags: html, text
  example: title_length(html: "<html><title>Home</title></html>", address: "page") is 4
  example: title_length(html: "<TITLE lang=\"en\"> Hello </TITLE>", address: "page") is 5

  let lowered be html.to_lower()
  let open_start be lowered.index_of("<title") otherwise fail with NoTitle(address: address)
  let after_open be html.drop(open_start)
  let tag_end be after_open.index_of(">") otherwise fail with NoTitle(address: address)
  let content be after_open.drop(tag_end + 1)
  let close_at be content.to_lower().index_of("</title>") otherwise fail with NoTitle(address: address)
  return content.take(close_at).trim().length()
end

public function page_title_length(address: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the web page at the given address and return the number of characters in its title element, failing with a clear error when the page has no title.
  tags: web, html
  see also: title_length
  expose as tool

  let url be Url(address) otherwise fail with BadUrl(address: address)
  let body: Text be web.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(address: address)
  return title_length(html: body, address: address) otherwise fail
end

test "the title length is counted"
  check title_length(html: "<html><head><title>Home</title></head></html>", address: "page") is 4
end

module page.title
  purpose: Measure the title of a web page for agents.

import std.http as web
import std.http exposing Url

public type TitleError is one of
  BadUrl(address: Text)
  FetchFailed(address: Text)
  NoTitle(address: Text)
end

public function title_text(html: Text)
  returns maybe Text
  purpose: Extract the text between the <title> and </title> tags, or nothing when the page has no title.
  tags: html, parsing
  example: title_text("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is "Hello"
  example: title_text("<TITLE lang=\"en\">Hi</TITLE>") is "Hi"
  example: title_text("<html><body>No title here</body></html>") is nothing

  let lowered be html.to_lower()
  let open_start be lowered.index_of("<title") otherwise return nothing
  let tag_end be lowered.drop(open_start).index_of(">") otherwise return nothing
  let body_start be open_start + tag_end + 1
  let rest be html.drop(body_start)
  let close_start be lowered.drop(body_start).index_of("</title") otherwise return nothing
  return rest.take(close_start)
end

public function page_title_length(address: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with TitleError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the web page at the given address and return the number of characters in its title element; fail with NoTitle when the page has no title.
  tags: web, html
  expose as tool

  let url be Url(address) otherwise fail with BadUrl(address: address)
  let page be web.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(address: address)
  let title be title_text(page) otherwise fail with NoTitle(address: address)
  return title.length()
end

test "the title text is found"
  check title_text("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is "Hello"
end

test "a page without a title yields nothing"
  check title_text("<html><body>Nothing</body></html>") is nothing
end

module page.titles
  purpose: Measure the title of a web page for agents.

import std.http as web
import std.http exposing Url

public type PageError is one of
  BadAddress(address: Text)
  FetchFailed(address: Text)
  NoTitle(address: Text)
end

public function title_length(html: Text)
  returns maybe Integer
  purpose: Count the characters between the opening and closing title tags, or give nothing when the page has no complete title element.
  tags: html, text
  example: title_length("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") is 5
  example: title_length("<TITLE lang=\"en\">Hi there</TITLE>") is 8
  example: title_length("<html><body>No heading here</body></html>") is nothing

  let lowered be html.to_lower()
  let open_index be lowered.index_of("<title") otherwise return nothing
  let after_open be html.drop(open_index)
  let tag_length be after_open.index_of(">") otherwise return nothing
  let content be after_open.drop(tag_length + 1)
  let close_index be content.to_lower().index_of("</title>") otherwise return nothing
  return content.take(close_index).length()
end

public function page_title_length(address: Text)
  returns Integer
  or fails with PageError
  needs network.http
  purpose: Download the web page at the given address and return the number of characters in its title element, failing with NoTitle when the page has none.
  tags: web, html, title
  expose as tool

  let url be Url(address) otherwise fail with BadAddress(address: address)
  let body: Text be web.get(url) otherwise fail with FetchFailed(address: address)
  let length be title_length(body) otherwise fail with NoTitle(address: address)
  return length
end
